engineOil.label: Engine oil
engineOil.blurb: Lubricant that reduces engine friction and cools heat.
engineOil.whyReplace: As it ages, viscosity breaks down, reducing power and fuel efficiency while increasing overheating risk.

engineOilFilter.label: Engine oil filter
engineOilFilter.blurb: Filters metal particles and impurities from engine oil.
engineOilFilter.whyReplace: A clog worsens circulation, accelerating engine wear and slowing response.

hydraulicOil.label: Hydraulic oil
hydraulicOil.blurb: Working fluid for the hydraulics that move the boom, arm, and bucket.
hydraulicOil.whyReplace: Degradation loses pressure, slowing work and weakening breaker force.

hydraulicFilter.label: Hydraulic filter
hydraulicFilter.blurb: Blocks contaminants in hydraulic oil to protect valves and pumps.
hydraulicFilter.whyReplace: A clog destabilizes the hydraulic circuit and affects precise control and power.

fuelFilter.label: Fuel filter
fuelFilter.blurb: Filters water and debris from fuel before it reaches the engine.
fuelFilter.whyReplace: A clog makes fuel delivery uneven and dulls travel and work response.

gearOil.label: Gear oil
gearOil.blurb: Protects travel and swing gearboxes from friction and impact.
gearOil.whyReplace: Low or degraded oil increases gear wear, making travel and swing heavy and noisy.

breaker.desc: Break road tiles in the crushing zone. Broken tiles respawn after a while.
